name: tallynix
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq pkg-config libssl-dev && curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y && . $HOME/.cargo/env && cargo install --locked typst-cli && mkdir -p ~/.ssh && cat ~/.host-key.pub >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys && chmod 700 ~/.ssh && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
